latest_post.display_name: 名古屋の長期投資家（なごちょう）
latest_post.summary: ニッポン高度紙工業を7500円台で売却。その後さらに上昇後下落。天井近くで売れたら良いとの考え。
latest_post.summary_en: Sold Nippon Kodoshi Corporation in the ¥7,500 range; after that it rose further and then fell, with the thought that it is good to be able to sell near the ceiling.
